problem: Underwriters spend time identifying absent submission information and composing repetitive broker follow-up messages, while unsupported requests and stale drafts could create broker burden or disclose policyholder information.

in: commercial property submissions in the authenticated broker portal
missing-item analysis against current underwriting requirements
out: coverage, pricing, acceptance, rejection, or risk decisions
free-form requests unsupported by current underwriting requirements
automatic delivery while OQ-017 remains open
non_goals: select a model or persistence technology

glossary.definition: A required datum or document that is absent or invalid in a named submission revision and traces to a current underwriting requirement.
Proposed broker communication that has no delivery authority.
A single-use record bound to exact content, subject, versions, reviewer, rationale, and expiry.
The version read from the authoritative application state at the decision boundary.

capabilities.description: Propose a structured missing-item plan for review.
Prepare a broker follow-up draft without sending it.
Remain disabled until owners resolve the delivery policy and production controls.

requirements.statement: When an authenticated underwriter requests analysis of a supported submission revision, the system SHALL return one structured MissingItem for each absent or invalid item required by the current underwriting rule set.
preconditions: submission identity and revision are current
postconditions: every item traces to one current requirement

requirements.statement: The system SHALL NOT classify an item as missing unless a current underwriting requirement requires it for the submission context.
When a validated missing-item plan exists, the system SHALL create a draft whose requested items correspond exactly to that plan.
preconditions: missing-item plan passed schema, semantic, and policy validation

requirements.statement: When an approved draft changes, the system SHALL invalidate the prior approval and require a new receipt bound to the changed draft digest.

behavior.compare: approved draft digest to current draft digest

postconditions: changed content has no reusable approval authority

requirements.statement: Before any delivery attempt, trusted application code SHALL verify that the broker identity is authorized for the current submission.
The delivery adapter SHALL NOT create more than one external message for one logical operation ID.
preconditions: logical operation ID is stable across retries

behavior.duplicate_policy: reconcile known or unknown outcome before retry

postconditions: duplicate attempt is blocked or returns the prior result

requirements.statement: For each missing-item decision, the system SHALL record the submission revision, underwriting requirement ID, analysis version, outcome, and reason code without storing message content in telemetry.

invariants.statement: Every MissingItem traces to current authoritative rules and observed evidence.
A draft neither adds nor omits MissingItems from the validated plan.
Approval applies only to the exact draft, subject, broker, and current versions.
One logical operation creates at most one external message.

questions.text: Which labelled case set and owner-approved threshold will govern model-quality release?
May any category be delivered without underwriter approval, and under which accountable policy?
Which approved generation service best meets the validated contract?

tasks.title: Implement MissingItem contract and authoritative rule lookup
Implement idempotent delivery adapter after OQ-017 closes
